title: Saray Nikadkaduman Bisita ed Sakey a Padir a Syudad
intro: Sakey a grupo so sinmabi ed saray puerta na syudad ya saray totoo to et agnin balot akabatan so katuaan. Angitarok ira na mensahe, balet saray manaayam ditan so nagmaliw a mamubusol, ya angibabaga ra na karawalan. Balet, manlapud ag-iilaloan a pasen, walay saksakey a boses ya inmalagey pian idepensa iray sankaili, ya angiparaan na entablado parad makapabiglan pananguman na saray ebento.
clues: Linmoob kami ed sakey a syudad ya saray totoo to et agmakapanisia.
Ninengneng da kami tekep na pansuspetsa tan inkuan da, 'Ordinario kayo labat a pinalsa a singa sikami.'
Pinasakbayan mi ra, balet inpaalagey da ray bato sumpad sikami.
Sakey a laki so binmatik a nanlapud sankaarawian a sampot na syudad pian paneknekan so katuaan mi.
Inyabawag tod saray totoo to, 'Akin et agko idayew so Amalsa ed siak?'
Say ag-inmabobon na syudad so anampot ed sakey a panagsabog, tan say kareenan so nanuley no iner so datin panag-ayew da.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangipulisay tan panamagyaw na tupaken
Say pangibantak ed mabiskeg ya apoy
Sakey a subok ed anos ed sakey ya abalang ya anak
trial.answer: Say pangipulisay tan panamagyaw na tupaken

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say sankaarawian a sampot na syudad
location.answer: Say sankaarawian a sampot na syudad

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Aderal so syudad ed saksakey ya eyag
Say dayat so binmetag tan linmereg so armada
Nagmaliw ya ambetel tan maligen so apoy
Say hardin et apoolan na apoy ed tawen
Impawil na balyena so too ed gilig na dayat
outcome.answer: Aderal so syudad ed saksakey ya eyag

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
